newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt bourse index closes at record 267.11 pts.
newsitem.headline: Egypt bourse index closes at record 267.11 pts.

text.p: The all-share index on the Egyptian bourse closed at a record high of 267.11 points on Tuesday.
The Capital Markets Authority index rose 4.51 from 262.6 on Monday.
It rose all last week on gains in cement and millng firms, closing on Sunday 6.6 points higher at 260.54 .
The previous record of 255.05 was set on October 19, 1994.
